queries.name: transaction
queries.sql: SELECT current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only, current_setting('server_version') AS version

queries.name: columns
queries.sql: SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='users' ORDER BY ordinal_position

queries.name: constraints
queries.sql: SELECT c.conname, c.contype, c.conrelid::regclass::text AS owner_table, c.confrelid::regclass::text AS referenced_table, pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) AS definition FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.conrelid IN ('public.users'::regclass,'public.platform_access'::regclass) OR c.confrelid='public.users'::regclass ORDER BY owner_table, c.conname

queries.name: indexes
queries.sql: SELECT t.relname AS table_name, i.relname AS index_name, x.indisunique, x.indisvalid, x.indisready, pg_get_indexdef(i.oid) AS definition FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid=x.indrelid JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid=x.indexrelid WHERE x.indrelid IN ('public.users'::regclass,'public.platform_access'::regclass) ORDER BY table_name,index_name

rows.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX platform_access_pkey ON public.platform_access USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX platform_access_user_platform_unique ON public.platform_access USING btree (user_id, platform)
CREATE INDEX idx_users_email_platform ON public.users USING btree (email, platform) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_users_external_id_platform ON public.users USING btree (external_id, platform) WHERE (external_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_email_unique ON public.users USING btree (email)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_pkey ON public.users USING btree (id)

queries.name: accounts
queries.sql: SELECT platform::text, role::text, count(*)::int AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE deleted_at IS NULL)::int AS undeleted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND is_active)::int AS active FROM public.users GROUP BY platform,role ORDER BY platform,role

queries.name: duplicates
queries.sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS conflicting_groups, coalesce(sum(n),0)::int AS conflicting_rows FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM public.users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY lower(trim(email)),platform HAVING count(*)>1) d

queries.name: cross_platform
queries.sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS shared_normalized_email_groups FROM (SELECT lower(trim(email)) FROM public.users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY lower(trim(email)) HAVING count(DISTINCT platform)>1) d

queries.name: normalization
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE email <> lower(trim(email)))::int AS noncanonical_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE trim(email)='')::int AS blank_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE email ~ '[[:space:]]' AND email <> trim(email))::int AS surrounding_whitespace_rows FROM public.users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

queries.name: grants
queries.sql: SELECT u.platform::text, count(*)::int AS active_accounts, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.platform_access p WHERE p.user_id=u.id AND p.platform=u.platform AND p.deleted_at IS NULL))::int AS missing_active_own_platform_grant FROM public.users u WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.is_active GROUP BY u.platform ORDER BY u.platform

queries.name: grant_integrity
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.id IS NULL)::int AS orphan_grants, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS deleted_grants, count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.id IS NOT NULL AND p.platform<>u.platform AND p.deleted_at IS NULL)::int AS cross_platform_grants FROM public.platform_access p LEFT JOIN public.users u ON u.id=p.user_id

queries.name: external_identity
queries.sql: SELECT platform::text, count(*) FILTER (WHERE external_id IS NULL)::int AS missing_external_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE external_brand IS NOT NULL AND external_brand<>platform::text)::int AS mismatched_external_brand FROM public.users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY platform ORDER BY platform

queries.name: external_duplicates
queries.sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS conflicting_external_identity_groups FROM (SELECT external_id,platform FROM public.users WHERE external_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY external_id,platform HAVING count(*)>1) d
